newsitem.title: MEXICO: Banco de Mexico net assets rise to Jan 24.
newsitem.headline: Banco de Mexico net assets rise to Jan 24.

text.p: Banco de Mexico said Tuesday its net international assets as of January 24 were $8.199 billion, compared to $8.100 billion on January 17.
The central bank said that its net international reserves as of January 24 were $18.147 billion, compared to $17.710 billion as of January 17.
The central bank said the increase of $99 million in net international assets in the same time period was due to:
--Net income from operations by the state oil company Pemex worth $158 million.
--The purchase of $120 million from credit institutions, a product of the partial exercising of options on the sale of dollars to the central bank that were issued during the auction of December 30.
--Net sales of foreign currency to the federal government worth $72 million.

--A let loss of $107 million dollars for a combination of factors including changes in the dollar value of non-dollar assets and liabilities held by the bank; net returns on interest rates and from trading of metals and securities; and net deposits in dollar accounts from commercial banks at the central bank.
Banco de Mexico said that between January 17 and January 24 the monetary base fell by 4.317 billion pesos due to a fall in the seasonal demand of bills and coins during the first weeks of the year.
In the same period, the government bank support program known as Fobaproa withdrew 3.529 billion pesos from its account to support a banking institution as previously arranged.

To compensate for the reduction of liquidity resulting from the various operations of the federal government, Banco de Mexico said it had opted not to renew 4.293 billion pesos from the balance of deposits that banks had constituted with the central bank.
The following tables detail Banco de Mexico's reserves and net domestic credit. All figures are in billions of pesos, unless otherwise indicated.
International Reserves
U.S. Dollars $17.710 bln $18.147 bln
Monetary Base 78.779 74.462
Net International Assets*
U.S. Dollars $8.100 bln $8.199 bln
Net Domestic Credit 15.375 10.343
*Net International Assets are defined as gross international assets minus central bank liabilities with the IMF and assets of less than a six-month duration from other central banks.
((--Dan Trotta, Mexico City newsroom +525 728-9507))
